zones.desc: A region located at the highest altitudes in the center of Lower Reshanta. The atmosphere is unstable due to its proximity to the depths of the Abyss.

zones.name: Black Fragments Area
zones.desc: An area of floating rocks or remains of fortresses destroyed in the Last War. It is the closest area to the eastern camp base and is relatively easy to access from the base by gliding.

zones.name: Devastated Remnants
zones.desc: An area of floating rocks or remains of fortresses destroyed in the Last War. It is the closest area to the western camp base and is relatively easy to access from the base by gliding.

zones.name: Archipelago of Siel's Wings
zones.desc: An area consisting of the main island in the south (Left Wing of Siel, Heart of Siel, and Right Wing of Siel) and the secondary island in the north (Grave of Steel).
